ai.topic: places people hope are still protected for people 100 years from now, shared at screenings of the conservation film America the Beautiful
ai.guidance: Approve any answer that names a place or a kind of place worth protecting: a national or state park, a river, lake, coast, forest, prairie, mountain, a hometown creek, a family ranch or farm, a neighborhood park, or a short reason with it. Feature answers that are specific and heartfelt. Never approve partisan content, named living politicians, parties, campaigns or policy fights, and never approve jokes, insults or places named to mock someone.
